The '''MK.10''' was a model of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It saw use against infantry.<ref name="DC" />
